body:
When I got to work, I need to be high or otherwise.  This proposes a big problem once I burn out.  I work wonderfully while still high, but the burnout kills all ambition to do any work at all.  I am not a regular caffeine user, so caffeine pills can have a surprisingly drastic effect.  To enhance my high, and to eliminate burnout (temporarily) I take a number of caffeine pills a half hour before work.  Smoke right before I go in, and the effects of the weed will be enhanced due to the head buzz of the caffeine.  If I have some bomb weed, and I take about 4 caffeine pills, I can easily still be high for an entire 5 hour shift.  I will feel the effects of the weed subside at about a usual time, but the mellowness and normality which pot heads (for lack of a better term) achieve by regularly smoking will remain much longer.
